prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Selection Layout: Redesign the initial story screen layout into a story_scroll experience with integrated path choices. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off, suggesting users get stuck reading early story content.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Safety Guarantee: Add reassurance text on the sign-in screen confirming existing pets and progress will be safely linked to your account. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing user anxiety during account setup.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub: Redesign the adoption pick_friend screen using a split layout to highlight pet personality alongside certificate creation. (why: Adoption has the highest single-step drop-off with only 63.2% conversion and a 1017s mean completion time.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Guide: Add clear image quality guidelines and hints on the photo upload screen to ensure high-fidelity pet generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight View for Story Screen: Change the story screen layout to a spotlight format to emphasize core pet narrative before path selection. (why: The median time for choose_path is fast (8s) but mean is 514s, showing a long tail of hesitant users.)
5: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Verification Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live visual status updates of the companion build process. (why: Home target step has high drop-off (81.3% pass rate) and long mean wait times (2336s).)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Quick-Access Notification: Add system tray quick-access instructions and notification toggle on the final home_intro screen. (why: Users report confusion about pet desktop behavior and post-onboarding feature misbehavior.)
